mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in WORKPLACES reduces commute-linked stopovers and midday errand trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks as weekday shopping occasions shrink.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 4-week mean even while WORKPLACES remains below -8% for the full next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while TRANSIT stays depressed, people consolidate trips near home and avoid discretionary outings, which lowers RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 3% and TRANSIT below -20% for at least 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 2 weeks after the RESIDENTIAL-high and TRANSIT-low condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS usage draws discretionary outdoor time away from shopping corridors, so a sustained PARKS increase precedes weaker RETAIL_REC over the next month.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 20 points on a weekly mean basis
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days after PARKS crosses above 20 and stays elevated for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A tightening in mobility restrictions first appears in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES, then suppresses in-person shopping demand, causing RETAIL_REC to fall over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT drops by more than 3 points week-on-week while WORKPLACES also falls week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the week after simultaneous week-on-week drops in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GROCERY_PHARM series absorbs routine shopping demand, and because that shift is a near-term substitution, RETAIL_REC weakens within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM staying above its recent 4-week average.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS falls while WORKPLACES rises, the same week signals a shift from leisure to routine commuting that supports retail foot traffic, raising RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean even after PARKS declines and WORKPLACES rises together for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run uplift in PARKS combined with higher RESIDENTIAL time indicates weather-driven localizing of activity, which reduces shopping trips and pushes RETAIL_REC lower within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 15 points while RESIDENTIAL stays above 4%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall in the week after PARKS and RESIDENTIAL simultaneously increase.

mechanism_narrative: During reopening, improving TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility signals restored access to shopping districts, so RETAIL_REC should rise over the next four weeks if those series continue to recover.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT turns upward for 2 consecutive weeks and WORKPLACES narrows its deficit
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not move above its prior 4-week mean over the next 28 days despite sustained improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.
